To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the economic leader is the one who creates new knowledge; (b) the go-between leader is the one to diffuse the knowledge; (c) the economic leader and the go-between leader are complementary to one another in the process of creating and diffusing new knowledge; and (d) the economic and go-between leaders are the key players in helping firms and countries invent new competitive strategies adapted to the world knowledge economy.
